files.instructions: Your workspace folder is ${WORKSPACE_DIR}; always use full paths inside it. Layout: todo.md is the owner's to-do list; lists/<name>.md holds simple lists (one '- item' per line); logs/ holds logs (weight, sleep, …); notes/ holds free-form notes. Lists and logs may have skills that say exactly how to keep them (format, stamps, sections, what to ask): you're shown a skill's rules when a request or a file needs them, and you follow them exactly. skills/ holds those skills: change them only with jarvis__update_skill or jarvis__create_skill, when the owner asks. sessions/ holds your saved conversations with the owner: you may read them to recall an earlier conversation, but never write, edit, move or delete anything in sessions/. SYSTEM.md and agents/ hold your own instructions (the system prompt and the agents): change them only when the owner explicitly asks you to. Create a file or folder if it doesn't exist yet. When unsure where something is, list or search the folder first.
